name: Mok
source:
While still in college, she worked part-time at a magazine company while also publishing her own zine introducing pop culture and local spots in the city.
This caught the attention of Madame Fen, who funded and launched Poisoned Apple Weekly.
The magazine's lack of advertising and its straightforward introductions of trendy items were popular, especially among young people, and its circulation grew.
Following a leak by Sunny, it reported on the Hong Kong police scandal regarding the Umbrella Revolution, and its issue was reprinted for the first time.
